packs.title: River and Realms
packs.promise: Connect Seville's royal, civic and river landscapes across a citywide route.

q.s: Choose one visible architectural scale and record three details that make it legible.
st: Use an open exterior or interior route permitted by the cathedral.
Choose one scale: doorway, chapel, column, tower or view.
Collect three written observations showing how that scale is built or framed.

q.s: Create a small atlas from three different tile or ceramic patterns you can see without entering restricted areas.
st: Choose an open arcade or bridge position.
Observe three distinct ceramic or tile patterns; do not rub or climb them.
Create an atlas with a shape, location and colour note for each.

q.s: Ride Line 1 from Puerta Jerez to Plaza de Cuba, then walk to Triana’s ceramic center.
st: At Puerta Jerez, verify a Line 1 train toward Ciudad Expo and board for Plaza de Cuba, the next west-bank stop.
Exit at Plaza de Cuba and follow a current public pedestrian route toward Centro Cerámica Triana at Calle Callao 16; choose safe crossings.
Record the station pair, the walk destination and two observable changes between the station area and the ceramics-center street.

packs.title: Santa Cruz and Triana
packs.promise: Spend two afternoons reading Seville through Santa Cruz and Triana.

q.s: Make a line study from one public stretch of Callejón del Agua and its wall or shade.
st: Choose a clear place along the public lane.
Find one wall line, one shade line and one opening.
Record how the three lines meet in a written mini-map.

q.s: Write a four-line miniature of the square using one shape, one colour, one sound and one place to rest.
st: Choose a respectful position at the edge of Plaza de Doña Elvira, clear of doorways and passing people.
Collect four ingredients from what is there today: a shape, a colour, a sound and an available public place to rest.
Arrange them into four short lines in any order. Let the final line invite someone to pause; use only a rest position you can actually see.

q.s: Cross Puente de Isabel II on the public pedestrian route and record three changes in view.
st: Begin at the east-bank approach and check the crossing is open.
Record one view toward the center, one along the river and one toward Triana.
